catalyst.name: Helping Hands, Sturm Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Grants 40 Handling and 20 Range.
Kills with Overcharged Rounds grants 2 stacks of 'Helping Hands'. Maximum of 6 stacks.
Helping Hands grants 50% decreased Stow/Ready Animation Speed while active. Readying Sturm or a Together Forevever weapon consumes one stack.
